# UNVR.JK — Unilever Indonesia (IDEATION 2026-11-06)

**Signal / why now:** new #6 INDO MOMENTUM row at Rp1,495, **−42.1% off the 52-week high** (mom12 −15.7%, mom6 +2.9%, mom1 −5.4%) on Rp37.0bn/day ADV — the heaviest-covered large cap on the board, so this is a name the desk has to have a written view on. Cheap-looking, and that is the whole case.

**Why DISCARD.** The base-rate note for `derated_compounder_rerating` is explicit: "the trap is a STRUCTURAL de-rating (local-challenger share loss, channel disruption) masquerading as a cyclical one … only a cyclical or sentiment de-rating with intact competitive position clears this archetype." UNVR's CAGR is **−0.19%** and mom12 is negative *while* the row sits in the MOMENTUM sleeve — momentum by residual factor score, not by price. Nothing in the screen shows the multiple-survival evidence (share, unit economics, volume) the archetype demands.

**Regime: AGAINST** — consumer staples sit under the desk's INDO rate-sensitive AVOID and there is no named variant: the domestic-demand recovery the bull case needs is what four years of falling EPS failed to deliver.

Archetype: `derated_compounder_rerating` · method card: VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY.

**Fast-disqualify:** EV at the prior (0.40/+50/−30) = +2.0%, thin; no valuation-anchored target is buildable without a share/volume dataset; the disqualifier is the archetype gate itself, so no Saturday depth is spent.
